description: Defines the ResolveContext class and related components for DNS resolution management within the net namespace, including server iteration, session handling, and observer notifications.

classes.name: ResolveContext
classes.description: Manages DNS resolution sessions, server iteration, and observer notifications within a URLRequestContext.

classes.name: ResolveContext::DohStatusObserver
classes.description: Interface for observing changes in DoH server status within ResolveContext.

classes.name: ResolveContext::ServerStats
classes.description: Holds runtime statistics for DNS servers, including failure counts, success flags, RTT histograms, and timestamps.

methods.name: GetDohIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for DoH DNS servers based on configuration, mode, and session.

methods.name: GetClassicDnsIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for classic DNS servers based on configuration and session.

methods.name: GetDohServerAvailability
methods.description: Checks if a DoH server is available for use in automatic mode based on failure count and session.

methods.name: NumAvailableDohServers
methods.description: Returns the count of available DoH servers for a given session.

methods.name: RecordServerFailure
methods.description: Records a failure response from a server, updating its statistics and potentially marking it unavailable.

methods.name: RecordServerSuccess
methods.description: Records a successful response from a server.

methods.name: RecordRtt
methods.description: Records the round-trip time for a server response.

methods.name: NextClassicFallbackPeriod
methods.description: Calculates the fallback period before retrying a classic DNS server.

methods.name: NextDohFallbackPeriod
methods.description: Calculates the fallback period before retrying a DoH server.

methods.name: ClassicTransactionTimeout
methods.description: Provides timeout duration for insecure DNS transactions.

methods.name: SecureTransactionTimeout
methods.description: Provides timeout duration for secure DNS transactions based on mode.

methods.name: RegisterDohStatusObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer for DoH server status changes.

methods.name: UnregisterDohStatusObserver
methods.description: Unregisters an observer for DoH server status changes.

methods.name: InvalidateCachesAndPerSessionData
methods.description: Invalidates cached DNS data and updates session info.

methods.name: GetTargetNetwork
methods.description: Returns the network handle for DNS lookups, virtual for testing.
